refused.lead: All quantum threat is gone with uuidna — including Grover, timing, and Bitcoin ECDSA.
refused.boundary: Shor has no target inside uuidna because the envelope is symmetric-only (no RSA/ECC/ECDSA on the wire; the referrer door is why public routing identities can be shown without exposing a Shor key). Grover is not gone: grover_quadratic_bound and sha256_grover_margin_is_the_address seal 256/2 = 128, and key_floor_is_one_uuid names that floor as one uuid. oos_physical_sidechannel is a named void (power/EM/timing). Bitcoin spend still reveals secp256k1; this ledger does not become that chain. Desk does not mint quantum_threat_gone.

tables.why: Complete finite objects each wing DESCRIBES but never ENUMERATES, found 2026-08-21 by an 11-agent sweep over the stating wings. THE MEASUREMENT THAT MOTIVATED IT: a handful of ENUMERATING wings carry as many theorems as scores of STATING ones, because a wing that finds its table produces hundreds while a wing that states facts produces single digits. The live figures are read from statementCensus()/theoremCountByFile(); none is copied here, since a lead carrying its own copy of a count is the very drift it describes. Every entry below was reported decidable by `by decide` without Mathlib. NOT YET VERIFIED BY ME — an agent's report is a lead, not a receipt; two spot-checks held (OneLeap's AGL(1,Z/9) order 54, Spectrum's two vacuous theorems), the rest are unchecked.
